cheatsheet.title: WK Cheat Sheet
cheatsheet.subtitle: Quick reference for the Wasteland King mechanics. Full doc in the repo under docs/.

geometry.p1: Zenith Plaza = center with Hub + 4 turrets (N/S/E/W). Mud = brown ring around it (attackable during WK). Green = normal map, unattackable in a foreign state.
geometry.p2: Turrets not in the same Alliance as the Hub fire on the Hub → permanent troop loss. So: everyone joins one temporary State-Alliance.

items: 8h consecutive Hub-Hold → Instant-Win + 30-min Hub-Shield
Otherwise: most total Hub-Occupation-Time after 24h
Consecutive-8h overrides total time. Holding a foreign Hub auto-shields your Home-Hub.

captain.note: Captain-Rally = Building-Capacity. The captain's troop stats apply to every incoming march. The strongest available player captains the Hub.

scoring.death_title: Death Points (ONLY Hub or turrets — Mud-deaths do NOT count)
scoring.occupation: Occupation: up to 2,000 points for a cumulative 120 min on Hub/turret. No reset when you get knocked off.

items: Starter → Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → Diamond → Legend (Top 15)
Gold+: Nataly frags unlocked (5 / 8 / 12 frags per event from the Ruler's-Hand box)
Gold+: Trophy LOSS if you only defend → you must offensively steal a foreign Hub
Governor's award boxes (King / Rulers / Loyalty / Contribution) for the winning Alliance, distributed by the governor
Capturing a foreign state doubles the box pool and grants a Coffer tax stream

loss.intro: Casualties → Infirmary → Deep Healing → Alliance Infirmary → PERMANENT
items: Without investment: 30% permanent. Maxed Miraculous Survival: ~18%
Deep Heal = free Nano Potions (slow). When full → Alliance-Infirmary trap
Alliance-Infirmary trap: if you still have troops in it when you leave the State-Alliance → they die permanently
Fast Comeback post-event: 300% training boost, capped at 120% of might lost (only Hub/turret deaths count toward the cap, not turret-fire or Mud-deaths)
Miraculous Survival maxed in Nova/Research
First Aid + Instant Heal commander talents loaded
Stockpile training speedups + resources (for FC consumption)
Fill the Infirmary with T1 taxis (high-tier deaths skip straight to Deep Healing)
Joined the State-Alliance
If mud-sitting: 3-day shield or 8h+1d stack
"No T11+ marches into Hub"
"No attacking on green"
"Mud-sit RSS gathering allowed both directions"
"48h statewide NAP" — kicks in around reset on WK day
State-Take vs NAP: take if each of your Top-3 True-Might beats the opponent's Top-1 AND you have enough taxi reserves at home for the Home-Hub
Concede early if overmatched — 24h of pointless defending costs weeks of retraining
Trigger FC sparingly: never bank more FC-cap than you can consume in 2 weeks
